LESSON: ISLAMIC RULES ON BUYING AND SELLING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.3: Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling, part of Muamalat (Social Relations) in Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What should Muslims avoid while buying and selling? 2. What are Islamic teachings on buying and selling?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. outline the Islamic rules on buying and selling to promote a healthy business society,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. state the benefits of observing the Islamic rules on buying and selling,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate Islamic etiquette on the rules and regulations of buying and selling to earn rewards from Allah (Q83: 1-6).

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. outline the Islamic rules on buying and selling to promote a healthy business society,

   Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. state the benefits of observing the Islamic rules on buying and selling,

   Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. appreciate Islamic etiquette on the rules and regulations of buying and selling to earn rewards from Allah (Q83: 1-6).

   Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss Islamic rules on buying and selling and make oral presentation,

2. discuss the benefits of observing Islamic rules and regulations on buying and selling,

3. search Hadith on buying and selling and write notes on lessons learnt using digital devices/books/resource persons,

4. role-play the Islamic rules and regulations on buying and selling,

5. name commodities that they have bought from the market,

6. undertake a project of creating a shop corner by collecting items, write a price list and a list of Islamic rules to be observed. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss Islamic rules on buying and selling and make oral presentation,
2. discuss the benefits of observing Islamic rules and regulations on buying and selling,
3. search Hadith on buying and selling and write notes on lessons learnt using digital devices/books/resource persons,
4. role-play the Islamic rules and regulations on buying and selling,
5. name commodities that they have bought from the market,
6. undertake a project of creating a shop corner by collecting items, write a price list and a list of Islamic rules to be observed. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and imagination: the skill of networking is enhanced as learners undertake a project of creating a shop corner by

collecting items, write a price list and a list of Islamic rules to be observed.

• Communication and collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking and teamwork discuss the benefits of observing Islamic

rules and regulations on buying and selling.

Values:
Responsibility as learners undertake a project of creating a shop corner by collecting items, writing a price list and a list of

Islamic rules to be observed.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Financial literacy as they practise buying and selling and create a shop corner.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Mathematics as they create a shop corner and indulge in buying and selling.
